About Ella

Operational Discipline & Analytical Heart

I’m an Administrative & Operations Specialist with a strong background in office management, executive support, and cross-departmental coordination in corporate and hospitality settings. I focus on streamlining workflows, managing schedules, verifying data, and keeping accurate documentation.

"Alongside my core administrative work, I actively apply my skills to business research, market analysis, and data storytelling."

Through personal and structured projects with Ace of Data (AOD), I have analyzed international research papers and prepared analytical reports covering agricultural export trends and pharmaceutical market-entry strategies. My goal is to combine operational discipline with strong research skills to solve real business problems and support team growth.

Cultivation Assessment & Market Dynamics

Indian Mango Production & Market Analysis

• Production & Yield Assessment: Spearheaded research into India's mango production metrics, historical yield trends, and regional climatic factors driving output.

• Farming Practices: Analysed state-level cultivation techniques and localized environmental conditions for output enhancement.

• Cross-Functional Integration: Partnered with logistics researchers to link farm-gate data with cold chain infrastructure and distribution.

• Yield Protection: Formulated strategic solutions to cut post-harvest wastage and strengthen market access.

Contributors: Thin Thin, myitzu and 3 others • Synthesis & Strategy
Satellite Remote Sensing
Data Assimilation & Weather Diagnostics

GNSS-PRO & Passive Microwave Sensor Integration

• Cross-Sensor Integration: Evaluated GNSS-PRO profiles vs passive MW radiance observations (ATMS, GMI) to address forward-modeling uncertainties.

• Ice Microphysics: Analyzed 2D ray-tracing simulations used to constrain ice crystal shapes, axis ratios, and radiative transfer accuracy.

• NWP Enhancements: Assessed assimilation of PRO phase shifts into 2D forward operators for forecast diagnostics.

• Constellation Roadmap: Assessed satellite orbit trade-offs (sun-synchronous vs. inclined) for global diurnal weather sampling.

Contributors: Thiri_Whar • Statistical Data Analysis, Visualisation
Regulatory Analysis
Statutory Frameworks & Market Entry

The Indian Pharmaceutical Industry Analysis

• Statutory Frameworks: Evaluated core regulations including Drugs and Cosmetics Act 1940, Drugs Rules 1945, and New Drugs Rules 2019.

• Commercial Compliance: Mapped OTC vs prescription regulations, Revised Schedule M (GMP) standards, and DPCO 2013 pricing constraints.

• Governance & Competition: Reviewed PCA 1988 anti-corruption laws with Competition Act 2002 pricing and M&A rules.

• Strategic Insights: Translated complex multi-tier statutes into actionable market-entry insights.
